name: DN Automotive Corporation
summary: DN Automotive Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive battery products in South Korea, China, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It also provides engineering solutions; and manufactures automotive tubes and automotive parts. In addition, the company offers automotive tubes, flaps, bladders, and CMB products; and machine tools for automotive, aerospace, and information technology industries. Further, it is involved in software development and supply, financial, and trading businesses; and transportation equipment rental activities.
